content: विलासः .²1 Sport, play, pastime. .²2 Amorous pastime, diversion, pleasure; as in विलासमेखला <ls>R. 8. 64</ls>; so विलासकाननम्, विलासमन्दिरम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Coquetry, dalliance, affectation, wantonness, graceful movement or play, any feminine gesture indicative of amorous sentiment; यातं यच्च नितम्बयोर्गुरुतया मन्दं विलासादिव <ls>Ś. 2. 2</ls>; कविकुलगुरुः कालिदासो विलासः <ls>P. R. 1. 22</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 26</ls>. .²4 Grace, beauty, elegance, charm; सहजविलासनिबन्धनं शरीरम् <ls>Māl. 2. 6</ls>. .²5 Flash, gleam. .²6 Liveliness, joviality (considered as a masculine virtue); शोभा विलासो माधुर्यं … पौरुषा गुणाः <ls>Daśarūpaka 2. 10</ls>. .²7 Lust.
